description: This Java source file defines an abstract class 'AbstractThingMappingStrategies' which provides helper methods for mapping Adaptable objects to thing commands within Eclipse Ditto's protocol adapter framework. The class includes methods for extracting various Ditto model objects (like Thing, Attributes, Features, AccessControlList, etc.) and related information from Adaptable instances, utilizing JSON parsing and object factory methods.

classes.name: AbstractThingMappingStrategies
classes.description: An abstract class providing static helper methods to map Adaptable instances to Ditto model objects such as Thing, Attributes, Features, AccessControlLists, etc., aiding in translating protocol messages to internal representations.

methods.name: authorizationSubjectFrom
methods.description: Creates an AuthorizationSubject from an Adaptable's payload path value.

methods.name: selectedFieldsFrom
methods.description: Extracts selected JsonFieldSelector from an Adaptable's payload.

methods.name: namespaceFrom
methods.description: Retrieves namespace string from an Adaptable's topic path, with placeholder handling.

methods.name: thingFrom
methods.description: Constructs a Thing object from the Adaptable's payload JSON value.

methods.name: aclFrom
methods.description: Constructs an AccessControlList from the Adaptable's payload JSON value.

methods.name: aclEntryFrom
methods.description: Builds an AclEntry from the payload path and JSON permissions.

methods.name: attributesFrom
methods.description: Creates Attributes object from JSON payload.

methods.name: attributePointerFrom
methods.description: Derives a JsonPointer to an attribute from the payload path.

methods.name: attributeValueFrom
methods.description: Extracts the JSON value of an attribute from payload.

methods.name: featureIdFrom
methods.description: Gets featureId string from payload path.

methods.name: featuresFrom
methods.description: Creates Features collection from JSON payload.

methods.name: featureFrom
methods.description: Constructs a Feature object from JSON payload.

methods.name: featureDefinitionFrom
methods.description: Creates a FeatureDefinition from a JSON array payload.

methods.name: featurePropertiesFrom
methods.description: Creates FeatureProperties from JSON object payload.

methods.name: featurePropertyPointerFrom
methods.description: Derives a JSON pointer to a feature property from payload path.

methods.name: featurePropertyValueFrom
methods.description: Extracts the feature property value from payload.

methods.name: policyIdFrom
methods.description: Creates a PolicyId object from JSON string payload.

methods.name: thingDefinitionFrom
methods.description: Creates a ThingDefinition from JSON string payload.

methods.name: leafValue
methods.description: Retrieves the leaf value of a JsonPointer, throwing exception if absent.
